basis.title: Basis
basis.default: Uncalibrated descriptive synthetic ranking, no confidence probability or budget forecast. 100 views and 20 carts in each signal window; 1000 impressions and 20 clicks per window, seven tracked days and identical ad series required. Score = capped positive view growth bps + cart rate bps + CTR bps + nonnegative historical expected contribution margin bps. Historical finance costs/reserves remain unchanged; missing costs abstain. Inventory must be clear/fresh. Later seven-day evaluation never enters the score; sustained means views do not decline and carts meet 20. Events are observations, not additional orders/revenue. Purchase pairs reference existing purchased products only. Coverage means supplied synthetic tracking days, not merchant completeness or statistical significance.

basis.title: Basis
basis.default: Descriptive spend/contribution association; assumes full budget delivery. Uncalibrated synthetic scenario, not causal response, calibrated LTV, incremental profit or a predictive backtest. Slope ranges are sensitivity, not confidence bounds.

basis.title: Basis
basis.default: Uncalibrated synthetic what-if, not a demand forecast or incremental profit. Baseline: selected bundle mix at full catalog price, explicit assumed sales, zero additional spend. Scenario: explicit sales assumption independent of markdown/spend; no fitted response. Catalog COGS are prospective synthetic estimates, never replacements for historical finance costs. Variable expense and expected return loss are per sold unit, additional spend charged once. Holding cost applies to all unsold selected stock for the full horizon; assumes sales at horizon start. Stock age is an assumption for every variant, not warehouse lot-age evidence. Markdown rounds down per unit to integer paise; excludes tax, assumes full delivery. Scenarios are alternatives and must not be added together. No discounts, bundles or campaigns are published.

basis.title: Basis
